title: DAILY FIGHTER — WEEK 1 DAY 6
emphasis: Foundation Tuesday MEDIUM: earned front-lever rung, horizontal strength, posterior-chain durability, spinal-engine control, rotational power, and aerobic engine

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min mobility. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/D×1 (19:25), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Easy Jump-Rope Flow
ignition.home: Jump rope 45 sec easy + relaxed march 15 sec ×10
ignition.away: Low-impact jumping jacks 45 sec + march 15 sec ×10
ignition.cue: RPE 5; loose shoulders, quiet landings, nasal recovery

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: FRONT-LEVER PROGRESSION
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE ≤8. Scapular-pull prerequisite completed 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-11; today advances leverage only. Gate: 3×15–20 sec twice before assisted tuck ice-cream makers.

exercises.name: Tuck Front Lever Hold
exercises.home: Pull-up bar or rings: tuck front-lever hold 10 sec
exercises.away: Feet-assisted tuck-row hold under a sturdy table 10 sec
exercises.cue: Depress shoulders; posterior tilt; hips level

exercises.name: Hollow-Body Hold
exercises.away: Floor: identical short-lever hollow hold 20 sec
exercises.cue: Posterior tilt; ribs down; breathe behind the brace

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: HORIZONTAL STRENGTH
deposits.effort: Rest 1:15; 3 RIR, RPE ≤8. Seated row establishes a clean baseline; chest press repeats the last verified 3×8 before reps advance.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Seated Row
exercises.home: Dopa Band seated row ×10 at 3 RIR
exercises.cue: Lead with shoulder blades; pause without leaning back

exercises.name: Dopa Band Standing Chest Press
exercises.home: Dopa Band standing chest press ×8 at 3 RIR
exercises.cue: Ribs down; reach smoothly; no shoulder glide

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: POSTERIOR CHAIN + SPINAL ENGINE
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; 3–4 RIR. Repeat known quality because prior hip-thrust load was not recorded; side plank builds anti-lateral strength.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.home: Barbell or dumbbell hip thrust ×10 at 3 RIR
exercises.cue: Finish with glutes; ribs stacked; no lumbar snap

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.away: Knee-supported side plank 25 sec/SIDE if needed
exercises.cue: Straight line; breathe; resist sag and rotation

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: ROTATIONAL POWER
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45. Deliberate Tuesday/Saturday power anchor; repeat 2026-09-12 quality before changing load. Stop when hip speed, distance, or posture drops.

exercises.name: Rotational Medicine-Ball Scoop Throw
exercises.home: Medicine-ball scoop throws ×3/SIDE into a safe wall
exercises.cue: Drive the floor; turn hips; brace the finish

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: AEROBIC ENGINE + SCAPULAR ARMOR
deposits.effort: One 8:15 block. Zone 2 stays conversational; then 10 easy reverse flies. Rest 0:20 after the armor set.

exercises.name: Zone-2 Treadmill
exercises.away: Brisk outdoor walk or easy jog for 7:00

exercises.name: Dopa Band X Reverse Fly
exercises.cue: Ribs stacked; shoulder blades lead; no shrug

martialSupplement.name: Guard Posture-Break Leg Activity
martialSupplement.home: Dummy + mat: alternating closed-guard posture-break leg activity
martialSupplement.away: Clear floor: controlled solo leg-and-hip action
martialSupplement.cue: Knees connect; curl hips; control the return
martialSupplement.text: Separate—not counted toward the physical workout or completion.
